text: BoltOdds: your key is fine. The settings your phone sends GitHub had the BoltOdds SOCKET switch off, so GitHub fell back to Bolt's REST snapshot (6 a minute per address) and got 429 on both keys for hours. Fixed: the engine now always reads Bolt by socket (your phone's switch is untouched). Engine restarted onto it at 03:04Z; I'm watching the first scans to confirm Bolt returns data.
